description: The link a person opens to buy tickets or register, with Spanish instructions to relay. For paid events (card or bank transfer), checkout opens with the ticket type and quantity already chosen. For free registration, it is the event page. Nothing is reserved or charged: the person completes it themselves.

quantity.description: For paid events: how many tickets the person wants.

slug.description: Which event: its slug, from search-events or the event URL (/e/{slug}).

ticket_type_id.description: For paid events: the ticket type id from get-event.

name: get-checkout-link

instructions.description: How to complete it, in Spanish. Relay it to the person.

methods.description: Ways to pay that are open now: card, transfer. Empty for free registration.

mode.description: free (register at no cost) or paid (buy a ticket).

presale.description: Free registration only: present while a followers-only presale is open.

ends_at.description: When the presale ends, ISO 8601 with offset.

ticket_type_ids.description: Ticket types held for followers until then.

quantity.description: Paid events: tickets the checkout opens with.

ticket_type.description: Paid events: name of the chosen category.

total.description: Paid events: price times quantity, before fees.

amount.description: Decimal amount with two places, e.g. "300.00".

note.description: What the total leaves out, in Spanish.

url.description: The link to give the person. Checkout for a paid event, the event page for free registration.

title: Get Checkout Link
